title: OLTP latency under analytical load
statement: The system shall keep OLTP p99 latency within 10% of its no-analytics baseline while analytical queries saturate the analytics replicas.
rationale: The purpose of dedicated analytics replicas is workload isolation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Running YCSB workload A concurrently with a multi-hop analytical traversal load at 100% analytics-replica CPU, OLTP p99 read and write latency increase by no more than 10% versus the same run without analytics.

source: Research default — PO to confirm 10% bound
